Answer: B
Reason: Figure 4 (axial CT at the lung bases) demonstrates a large, inhomogeneous soft-tissue mass in the left posterior costophrenic/epidiaphragmatic region with relatively smooth margins, consistent with a recurrent hemangiopericytoma; the other options describe locations (upper lobe, pulmonary ligament, 2nd rib) or features (spiculation, rib invasion without calcification) not supported by the provided images.
